segments.text: She is a college student who attends the same university as the main character.
Her atmosphere is innocent, yet she exudes a certain allure, and she is popular with many boys who are attracted to her pheromones.
While attending university, she is also working on her creative writing, aiming to become a novelist, and because of this, she does not know many people around her.
She has a cheerful, sincere, and earnest personality and is very friendly, but she doesn't allow anyone in her private life.
She is seen by others as a slightly mysterious woman.
In fact, her family are well known in the porn industry, and because of this, she has acquired a wealth of sexual knowledge.
She is a lecher who is always having lewd fantasies, which she is ashamed of and hides.
Translated from
主人公と同じ大学に通う女子大生。
雰囲気は清楚なのにどことなく妖艶な気配を漂わせており、そのフェロモンにあてられた多くの男子から人気を得ている。
大学に通いながら小説家を目指して創作活動をしており、その兼ね合いで周囲との付き合いは浅く、明るく誠実で真面目な性格で人当たりもいいのに誰もプライベートに踏み込ませてはくれない。
ちょっとミステリアスな女性として周りからは見られている。
実は家族がポルノ関係で名の売れている人間であり、その影響で性知識だけ豊富に得てしまった耳年増。
常日頃から何かあればすぐ淫らな妄想に結びつけてしまうむっつりスケベで、本人はそれを恥じて隠している。

与主人公同一个大学的女大学生。虽然给人清纯的感觉但是总觉得散发着妖艳的气息，在很多被其荷尔蒙吸引的男性中很有人气。一边上大学一边以小说家为目标进行活动，所以很少有社交，虽然有着开朗诚实认真的性格而且人缘也很好，但是不会让任何人踏入其私生活，被周围人认为是有些神秘感的女性。实际上其家人在色情领域是比较有名的人，所以因为这个影响性知识方面十分丰富。日常生活中，一有什么风吹草动就会陷入色情的妄想中，这个名副其实的闷骚型，其本人也非常害羞而在可以隐藏。
A barmaid who works at a well-known and secluded bar.
She has a sharp and handsome face and a fascinating body that radiates an exquisite sex appeal, her cool, caring, and good-natured personality attracts a great deal of attention.
She is more popular among female customers than male customers because of her good-looking appearance, and she is often consulted at the counter mainly on love affairs.
She is often seen as a "successful adult with a lot of experience in love" and as "someone who can win any man over".
In reality, however, she is a caretaker wife who works hard for her week and feeble husband.
Instead of playing a man's tricks, she is a woman who cannot refuse his requests and takes on unnecessary hardships when he asks her for help.
She loves her husband from the bottom of her heart and believes that if she continues to support him, he will become a great husband.
Translated from
隠れ家的名店のバーで働くバーメイド。
キリリとした端正な顔付きで極上とも言えるほどに色気を放つ蠱惑的な身体と、クールながらに気遣いの出来る器量のいい性格が非常に高い注目を集めている。
そんな格好いい女性としての姿が、男性客よりも女性客の方から人気で、よくカウンターで主に恋愛関係の相談に乗っており、
そのため「恋愛経験豊富なデキるオトナ」「男を手玉にとってそう」などと評価される。
しかし実態は、甲斐性の無い気弱な夫のためにせっせと働く世話焼き女房で、男を手玉に取るどころか、頼られると断れず余計な苦労を背負い込む一面を持つ。
夫のことは心の底から愛しており、自分が支え続けていればきっと立派な夫になってくれると一途に信じている。
She is a gal girl who attends an all-girls school.
Her motto is to have fun doing what she loves, and she spends her days playing around town with her schoolmates.
She especially enjoys playing tricks on grown men, and enjoys teasing the male teachers at the school and other adults who seem to be up to no good.
Because she is shrewd and cunning, she manages to avoid critical situations even when playing such games.
She is seen by her female friends as a cool, mature woman with a hundred battles under her belt and is held in high esteem, but she herself is a virgin who has never been with a man.
She is basically a fearless person with a winning spirit and a good sense of humor, but when she is cornered, her inexperience takes its toll on her and she gets upset and shows her weakness.
Translated from
男子禁制の女子校に通う今時風ギャルな女子学生。
好きなことをして楽しく生きることをモットーにしており、日々学園の女子仲間達と街に繰り出して遊び過ごしている。
中でも大人の男を翻弄することを何よりの楽しみとしており、学園の男性教師をはじめ、街中でもダメそうな大人をからかって遊んでいる。
抜け目がなく狡猾さを備えているため、そんな遊びをしていても上手く危機的状況を回避している。
そんな姿が周りの女子仲間からは百戦錬磨の格好いい大人の女として捉えられ、尊敬の対象に祭り上げられているが、本人は未だ男性経験のない処女。
基本的には勝ち気でノリのいい恐れ知らずの性格だが、追い詰められると経験の浅さが仇となり狼狽して弱気を見せてしまう。

女子学校上学的辣妹女高中生。快乐生活做自己想干的事是自己的座右铭，每天与学校的同伴们逛街游玩。从学校的男老师到街上看上去没出息的大人，玩弄男性大人是其最开心的事。其丝毫不露破绽加上也很狡猾，无论再怎么玩也能轻松躲避危机。所以被其周围的女性同伴视为尊敬的对象，被当作身经百战的成熟女性，但其本人是没有男性经验的处女。基本上是天不怕地不怕的性格，但是一道紧要关头其经验浅薄就暴露无疑，表现出狼狈与弱气的一面。
She is one year younger than the protagonist and is a cousin who attends the same university.
She is shy and withdrawn, and is not good at interacting with others.
Although she is beautiful, her expression is dark and she rarely asserts herself, so her presence is very weak.
Her shadowy and timid appearance, which is quite intriguing if one looks closely, attracts the attention of the students,
She is chosen as a test subject by the protagonist, after he acquired his ability, and is subjected to various pranks, even losing her virginity without her knowledge.
After that, she is often invaded and played with, and she is beginning to realize that someone invisible is playing tricks on her.
Translated from
主人公の一つ年下の従妹で同じ大学に通っている。
内気で人見知りが激しく、他人と関わるのが苦手。
美人ではあるのだが表情が暗く、自己主張をほとんどしないため存在感が非情に薄い。
その影の薄さや弱気さ、よく見ればそそる外見に目を付けられ、能力を手に入れた主人公の実験台に選ばれ、様々な悪戯をされて本人が知らないうちに処女まで奪われてしまっている。
その後もたびたび家に侵入されて身体を弄られ続けた結果、自分が見えない何かに悪戯されていることに何となく気づきかけている。
与主人公同一个大学比其小一岁的表妹。非常内向与怕生，不善于与人交往。虽然是个美女但是总阴沉着脸，基本不会进行自我展示所以存在感很薄弱。虽然存在感薄弱又内向，但是仔细看的话又有着吸引人的外表，所以被获得能力的主人公盯上选为了实验对象，进行了各种各样的恶作剧，甚至在本人不知道的情况下连处女也被夺走。在这之后，家里就被时不时入侵，身体也被一直玩弄，最终也开始发觉自己被看不见的什么进行着恶作剧。
She has been working as a private detective since she was a student.
Despite her young age, she is a capable girl backed up by her excellent insight and has solved many cases.
Her achievements and her pretty appearance have earned her the nickname 'beautiful girl detective'.
However, she is also a very confident person with a strong sense of justice as a detective, and when she she sees a case, she is a headstrong troublemaker.
She was involved in a case when the protagonist was experimenting with his abilities and was molested by his invisible hand,
She is pursuing the protagonist to investigate the paranormal events that happened to her at that time.
Translated from
学生の頃から私立探偵として活動している女性。
若いながら優れた洞察力に裏打ちされた確かな実力を持っており、これまでいくつもの事件を解決してきた。
その功績と可憐な美貌から美少女探偵と持て囃されている。
しかし、一方でかなりの自信家で探偵としての強い使命感と正義感を持っており、事件と見れば自ら首を突っ込んでいく猪突猛進なトラブルメーカー。
主人公が能力の実験をしていた時に巻き込まれて、目に見えない手で悪戯されたことから、その時自分の身に起きた超常的な出来事の究明のために主人公を追っている。
学生时代就开始当私立侦探的女性。年纪轻轻就有着优秀的洞察力和不可比拟的实力，至今为止解决过多个事件。因为其功绩与美貌，作为美少女侦探在世间小有名气。但是，一方面本人有着相当的自信与作为侦探强烈的使命感与责任感，一发现事件就会不顾一切地投入其中，也是个名副其实的问题制造者。主人公进行能力实验的时候有被卷入其中，从被看不见的手进行恶作剧开始，为了探究这发生在自己身上不合常理事情的真相开始调查主人公。
A college student living alone away from his parents.
Having lived in a boys' school for a long time, he came out from the countryside with a strong desire for the opposite sex.
However, when he arrived at the university, his lack of experience made it difficult for him to talk to woman, and he was unable to make proper contact with them.
Because of this, he was shunned by not only the opposite sex, but also by boys as well.
He used to have a positive and cheerful personality, but his continuous failures made him discouraged, and he became an inconspicuous and unobtrusive person at the university.
He was an unattractive man with immense desires.
However, his life changes drastically when he suddenly acquires the ability to control perception.

Taking advantage of being able to do as he pleased without anyone noticing, he became accustomed to the opposite sex by breaking into the homes of women close at hand, peeping into their lives and playing sexual pranks on them, acquiring practical knowledge of the female body in the process.
Overcoming his difficulties gave him confidence, and he regained his former positive personality.
